design_name: Wheel Drive Bench Demonstrator - FF-130 Motor Candidate Envelope POC-08
assumptions: This is a simplified body envelope for an unselected motor candidate, not a complete motor model or approval of the candidate.
The 20.4 mm by 15.4 mm by 25.1 mm body dimensions are carried forward from the parent project contract's Mabuchi FF-130SH-14230 candidate entry.
The 25.1 mm body length is oriented along global +Y; the 20.4 mm and 15.4 mm section dimensions lie along global X and Z respectively.
The box omits the motor shaft, terminals, mounting details, internal features, and manufacturing geometry.
Per the user's direction, verification is deferred until all planned parts have been created.
